abstract: OBJECTIVE: To determine predictors of prognostic significance for patients with nonseminomatous testicular cancer (NSTC) who have advanced disease at the time of presentation. DESIGN: A chart review with a mean patient follow-up of 5.5 years (range from 0.75 to 13 years). SETTING: University hospitals in Halifax. PATIENTS: All patients with NSTC, stages II-B, II-C and III. Patients were excluded if the follow-up status at the time the study closed could not be determined. Thirty-three patients were included in the study. Current patient status was determined from the clinical charts and personal communication with the patients or their physicians. INTERVENTIONS: All patients received cisplatinum-based chemotherapy. The extent of the disease was assessed by chest radiography or lung tomography, bone scanning, abdominal computed tomography or lymphangiography. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: Correlation between levels of beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (BHCG) and alpha-fetoprotein (AFP), comparison of duration of symptoms before initial treatment, response to treatment and survival, and relationship between stage, tumour volume and survival. RESULTS: The 3-year overall survival rate was 76%. Seven of 18 patients with symptoms for more than 16 weeks died of disease (p < 0.01). Overall complete response was seen in 27 of 33 patients. All initial nonresponders died. A survival rate of 93% was seen among initial complete responders (p < 0.01). All seven patients with persistent elevation of BHCG levels (p < 0.001) and the two patients with persistent elevation of AFP levels (p < 0.01) after the second course of chemotherapy died. CONCLUSIONS: A symptomatic interval of more than 16 weeks, poor response to initial treatment, bulky retroperitoneal disease, larger volume lung disease and persistently elevated levels of BHCG and AFP were all indicators of poor prognosis.
abstract_ja: 目的：進行期で診断された非セミノーマ性精巣がん(NSTC)患者の予後因子を明らかにすること。デザイン：診療録のレビュー。平均追跡期間は5.5年(0.75～13年)。設定：ハリファックスの大学病院。対象：病期IIB、IIC、IIIのすべてのNSTC患者。追跡状況が研究終了時に確定できなかった患者は除外した。33例が対象となった。現況は診療録と患者または担当医との個人的連絡から確認した。介入：全患者がシスプラチンを基盤とした化学療法を受けた。病変の広がりは胸部X線または肺断層撮影、骨シンチグラフィ、腹部CTまたはリンパ管造影で評価した。主要評価項目：β-hCGとAFPの値の相関、初回治療前の症状期間、治療反応および生存の比較、病期・腫瘍量と生存の関係。結果：3年全生存率は76%。16週間以上症状があった18例中7例が病死した(p<0.01)。全体の完全奏効は33例中27例で得られた。初回無効例はすべて死亡した。初回完全奏効例の生存率は93%であった(p<0.01)。2コース目の化学療法後もβ-hCG値が持続的に高値であった7例(p<0.001)およびAFP値が持続的に高値であった2例(p<0.01)は全例死亡した。結論：16週間を超える症状期間、初回治療への不良な反応、巨大な後腹膜病変、より大きな肺病変、β-hCGおよびAFPの持続的高値は、いずれも予後不良の指標であった。
